tax._kiddie_note: Unearned income above $2,700 (2 x $1,350, Rev. Proc. 2025-32) is taxed at the parent's rate, federal (Form 8615) and CA (FTB 3800). Applies to a full-time student 19-23 whose earned income is not more than half of his own support.
tax._parent_note: Kilian 2026-10-20 22:04Z: parent in NYC, 37% federal bracket. Parent's NY/NYC rates do not apply to Kilian's gains (no NY kiddie tax under Form 8615).
tax._flat_note: Kilian 2026-10-20 22:04Z: the parent claiming him lives in New York City (37% federal bracket; NY 9.65%, NYC 3.876% at the parent's income). Federal kiddie tax (Form 8615): unearned income above kiddie_threshold ($2,700) at the parent's federal rates, short-term 37%, long-term 20% (the 37% bracket is above the 20% LTCG start, Rev. Proc. 2025-32); up to the threshold at Kilian's own federal rates, 10% short-term (wages $20k less the $16,100 dependent standard deduction leave ~$3.9k taxable, inside the 10% band to $12,400) and 0% long-term. New York has no kiddie tax when Form 8615 is used: the child's investment income is reported on the child's own NY return and taxed at the child's own rates (NYS IT-201-I, 'Does your child have investment income over $2,700?'). So NY and NYC tax every gain at Kilian's own marginal rates: NY 5.40% ($13,900-80,650) + NYC 3.762% ($12,000-25,000), single, 2026 schedules (NYS IT-2105-I 2026); NY dependent standard deduction $3,100. Assumed: Kilian is domiciled at the parent's NYC home (a dependent student keeps the parents' domicile) and his CT dorm is not a permanent place of abode. NIIT dropped (Kilian 2026-10-21 00:48Z 'yes you may drop it'; it was kept per his 2026-10-01 20:32Z ask): Form 8960 applies it on the child's own MAGI over $200,000 (single), which his income does not reach. Short-term = 37% + 9.162% = 46.162%; long-term = 20% + 9.162% = 29.162%; own rates under the threshold 19.162% / 9.162%. Was CA (41.3% / 28.1% / 14% / 2%) until 2026-10-20. Net losses offset gains; up to $3,000 deducts at the own short-term rate. Bracket mode (mode 'brackets') still holds the CA schedule and is not updated.
tax._short_term_all_note: Kilian 2026-10-28 card 'Assume short-term on all' (thread 'Fix AMAT target vs sell mismatch'): every holding is assumed sold within the year at the short-term rate, so a trim only pays the same tax H years sooner; band per year = q tau (1 - (1+d)^-H) / H + spread / T. Overrides lot_aware_horizon; false restores it.
tax._lot_aware_note: Kilian 2026-10-20 card 'Lot-aware' (Assumption audit thread): a short-term lot's trim band compares selling now with holding it to its one-year date and selling long-term: band per year = q (tau_now - flat_long_term_rate (1+d)^-X) / X, X = years until the oldest (FIFO) lot turns long-term (floor 1 day), plus spread / T. Long-term lots keep the T-year rule (years_until_you_would_otherwise_sell, future_rate_on_deferred_gains, Claude defaults 2026-09-28). false restores the T-year rule for every lot.

_dcf_policy_note: Kilian 2026-10-21 08:05Z chose 'Turn it on, tested weights' (card dcf_v2_reenable), after the 07:23Z no-DCF rule. mode v2: model_engine.py sets the DCF weight, rate, fade and terminal by script. Rate = 10y (Yahoo ^TNX) + Damodaran's monthly implied ERP (T12m) x (0.768 + 0.232 beta), data/erp/erp.json from erp_update.py; debt at the argued marginal cost or 10y + 1 pt (judgment), 21% shield. 3 detailed years, growth fades to 3% by year 10, terminal NOPAT x (1 - g/RONIC)/(WACC - g), RONIC argued, default 15%, never below WACC; signed contracts in `contracts` at the counterparty credit rate to full term. Weight 0.4 = walk-forward rule applied for 2026 on the WRDS harness with Damodaran's premium (all stocks, 2008-09..2024-12, wrds/results/dcf_bias/damodaran_weights.csv; also 0.4 with the solved premium, implied_erp.csv). Software and interactive media 0: DCF alone far worse than P/E and the blend does not beat P/E under either premium (t -1.0 / -1.1). Other segment weights flipped between premium sources, so they are not used (consistent with dcf-weight-dims 2026-10-20). Exclusions: GPU-life neoclouds and pre-profit names (also automatic when last detailed year NOPAT <= 0). gics_groups: GICS 451030/502030 (soft_internet), 4530 (semis); names not listed take their sector only.
